title: Mobile drawer focus visibility correction at narrow widths
summary: Keyboard testing exposed pre-existing drawer header overflow at 320px; reused existing storefront responsive header classes inside the drawer.

changes.detail: Add existing storefront-header-bar, storefront-header-brand and storefront-header-logo classes only to drawer header. Keeps all controls and French content; eliminates horizontal drawer scrolling when focusing clipped actions. No CSS file or dependency changes.
